mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are currently 37 degrees with overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park under a Waning Gibbous moon. The overnight low will be 32 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

For local news, the City of Verona has announced that candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are available for all four Aldermanic Districts. Candidates must file their Declaration of Candidacy and other required paperwork with the City Clerk at 111 Lincoln Street by 5:00 p.m. on January 5, 2027.

There are several events to enjoy in the coming days. Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy the Thursday Night festivities at ART House 360, or join the fun at Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run, a 50-year craft brewing celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and more.

In our weekly police report, we look back to November 3, when officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Prairie Way Boulevard where a 31-year-old man was arrested for intimidation of a victim and disorderly conduct.
Culver's is now closed for the night. Be sure to stop by tomorrow when they open at 10:00 AM to enjoy the flavor of the day, which will be Snickers Swirl.
